sql: select market_ticker, side, action, limit_price, quantity, status, right(coalesce(cancel_reason,''),30) cr, created_at::text, (select string_agg(at::text || chr(32) || residual_cents, chr(124)) from incentive_balance_observations where at > timestamp '2026-10-14 11:00' and residual_cents > 99) credits, (select balance_cents::text from incentive_balance_observations order by at desc limit 1) bal, (select quantity_fp::text from positions where market_ticker='KXTOP10BBSPOTS-26OCT24-TSWIF-10' order by captured_at desc limit 1) tswif from live_orders where strategy='Alimm1' and (created_at > '2026-10-14 11:40' or status in ('resting','partial','pending','submitted')) order by created_at desc limit 20
